title: The vertex reconstruction conjecture
formal: Is every finite simple graph with at least three vertices determined up to isomorphism by the multiset of its vertex-deleted subgraphs?
context:
Multiplicity in the deck matters. Reconstruction from distance queries, infinite graphs and directed graphs are different models.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: Tests whether a whole combinatorial structure is determined by all of its one-vertex views, with a direct graph-isomorphism connection.
